title: Length of a re.split result for a tag-list pattern
prompt:
Our tag parser splits free-text tag lists with

    parts = re.split(r'\s*([,;])\s*|\s+and\s+', text)

and then walks `parts` two items at a time as (tag, separator) pairs, which is going wrong for some inputs. For

    text = 'red, green;blue and  yellow'

(note the two spaces after `and`), how many elements does that `re.split(...)` call return on CPython 3.8 or newer?

Answer with a single integer.
